text:
sana: FYI EU2 GPU warm pool failing to complete join. Kubelets erroring on secret fetch (KMS PermitDenied).
eli: Error snippet?
sana: From keystore sidecar on gpu-eu2-worker-11:
```
2026-03-23T11:02:10Z ERROR keystore: PermitDenied: kms:Decrypt denied for arn:aws:kms:eu-west-2:111:key/zzzz-9999
```
sana: We've just rolled a firewall + vpce policy tighten to enforce audit boundaries. Looks like the vpce policy now blocks the keystore principal.
ravi: That explains the 50x 403s. Ops alert spiked. ops-bot: alert keystore.kms.denied 403 count=54 url=https://ops/alerts/keystore-kms
sana: The keystore path uses privatelink to our regional grant broker; the new policy included a Deny for broad privatelink principals. It shadowed the existing allow for keystore role.
eli: Can we short-term add an explicit grant or relax the vpce policy? Which is faster?
oncall-sre: Two paths: 1) emergency KMS grant scoped to keystore role + 1hr TTL + patch vpce policy to add explicit Allow for keystore prefixes (preferred), 2) full rollback of vpce change (faster but rolls back audit fix). Recommend 1.
ravi: Approve emergency grant for 2h. Put guardrails in place.
sana: Proposed commands:
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/keystore-eu2 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::111:role/keystore-privatelink --operations Decrypt --constraints "{\"EncryptionContextSubset\":{\"service\":\"keystore\"}}"
aws ec2 modify-vpc-endpoint --vpc-endpoint-id vpce-0f1e2d --policy-document file://vpce-keystore-allow.json
```
eli: Make the endpoint policy change minimal (only kms:Decrypt and s3:GetObject on /keystore/*). Test in eu2-az1 canary.
ops-bot: deploy request created by rami at 11:20 https://deploy/7890
sana: Created grant id g-0cafebabe, testing on a canary node now.
sana: Canary node succeeded decrypt -> kubelet pulled secrets -> pod Ready.
oncall-sre: Rolling canary to other azs. Monitoring synthetic keystore.Decrypt and kubelet readiness. If >20% fail after 10m, we'll rollback.
ravi: Note for follow-up: add a case in vpce policy CI that rejects Deny statements that could shadow service-specific allows.
eli: Also cost heads-up: if we mirror audit logs per region to avoid tight vpce denies, S3 incremental cost estimate ~USD 140/day for EU2. Include in audit PR.
sana: All good so far, 14/16 recovered after patch. Will close thread after full recovery and short postmortem.
ops-bot: alert status still open, awaiting human close https://ops/alerts/keystore-kms
